name: foxwarm_discover
description: Search available Foxwarm tools and inspect their inputs. Results identify each tool's source and, where applicable, its Node or MCP server. A listed tool may still require permission for the arguments used in a call.

query.description: Words to match in tool names and descriptions. Omit to list tools.

sources.description: Tool sources to include. Omit to search supported sources.

nodeId.description: Limit Node tools to this Node.

server.description: Limit outbound MCP tools to this configured server.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tools to return.

includeSchema.description: Include input schemas with the returned tools.

name: foxwarm_call
description: Call a tool by the exact toolId returned by foxwarm_discover. The call uses this external session's identity and checks permission for the resolved tool, target, and arguments.

args.description: Arguments accepted by the selected tool.

name: foxwarm_node
description: List accessible Nodes, inspect this external session's current Node, or select a Node for subsequent calls.

action.description: list shows accessible Nodes; status shows this session's current Node and working directory; select changes its current Node.

nodeId.description: Exact Node ID to select. Required for select.

name: foxwarm_exec_result
description: Read the status and output of a command started by this external session, or list its known execution IDs. Results remain available only while this session is retained; closing a connection does not itself stop a command.

execId.description: Execution ID to inspect. Omit to list this session's known executions.

limit.description: Maximum executions to return when execId is omitted.

name: foxwarm_session
description: List Foxwarm Sessions, read a Session's current conversation and execution state, or send it a message. Read defaults to the latest 10 visible records. A successful send confirms that the message was queued, not that the Session has read or answered it.

action.description: list shows a bounded Session catalog; read returns current conversation and execution state; send queues a message for an exact Session.

sessionId.description: Exact internal Session ID for read or send. Current-session and parent aliases are not accepted.

start.description: Zero-based offset for list, or active-history index to read forward from. Negative read indices count from the end. Omit start and before to read the newest page; do not combine them.

count.description: Maximum entries for list (default 20, range 1–50), or visible source records for read after applying parts (default 10; 0 returns only execution state and page information). Read selection ends at the available history boundary; text filters can leave fewer matches.

previewLength.description: Total character budget for the read preview. Omit or use 0 for the default; other values are bounded to 1,000–20,000.

message.description: Non-empty message to queue when action is send.

allowReply.description: Allow the receiving Session to send an explicit reply through the client's active Foxwarm notification connection. Omitted or false does not provide a reply destination.

before.description: Exclusive active-history index to read backward from. Use the value returned for the older page; do not combine with start. Applies to read only.

historyVersion.description: History version returned by an earlier read. Supply with start or before to detect a structurally changed range. Applies to read only.

parts.description: Content to show: text, tools, or images. Defaults to all three. Hiding tools preserves commentary in mixed messages; text and images belonging to tool results stay with tools. Applies to read only.

contentFilter.description: Keep selected records containing this literal text, ignoring case. Searches the included content of the selected page, not the entire history. Applies to read only.

includeRegex.description: Keep selected records whose included content matches this regular expression, ignoring case. Applies to read only.

excludeRegex.description: Exclude selected records whose included content matches this regular expression, ignoring case. Applies to read only.

toolDetail.description: Tool display detail: names (default) groups names and counts; snippets adds short argument/result excerpts; full expands them within the response budget. Applies to read only.
